name: morphine dose correction
description: A paramedic corrects a drug dose mid-read-back. The agent must reconcile against the words the listener actually heard, and relay only the corrected, confirmed value. All patient data is synthetic.

turns.text: This is a 34 year old male, fall from height at 14:05, GCS 13.
BP is ninety over sixty, sats 91 percent.
Wait, that was morphine five milligrams.
